Created `tests/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/FastDatePrinterAgentTest.java`, a self-contained JUnit 4 test class covering:

- Constructor NPE checks (null pattern/timeZone/locale)
- Accessors (`getPattern`, `getTimeZone`, `getLocale`) and the `FULL/LONG/MEDIUM/SHORT` constants
- All `format` overloads (`long`, `Date`, `Calendar`, buffer variants, and the `Object/StringBuffer/FieldPosition` overload), including epoch, pre-epoch, and unsupported-type error cases
- `getMaxLengthEstimate()` as an upper bound on actual output length
- `equals`/`hashCode`/`toString` contract (reflexivity, differing pattern/zone/locale, null/wrong-type comparisons)
- Documented `Z`/`ZZ` RFC822/ISO8601 timezone formatting and the Java 7 year-pattern behavior (`y`, `yy`, `yyy`, `yyyy`)
- SimpleDateFormat-compatible quoting (literal text, escaped `''`), locale-dependent names, and 12/24-hour clock
- Protected `applyRules`, `parseToken`, `parsePattern` (including the invalid-pattern `IllegalArgumentException`), and `selectNumberRule`
- `Serializable` round-trip

`./compile.sh` reports `compiled OK`.
